Subject: Outstanding invoice 7812 + W-9 request

Hi Ava,

Hope you’re doing well. We’re processing payment for Invoice #7812 (due 2027-05-02, attached) but our bank needs a completed W-9 on file for the legal payee before we can release the wire. Can you confirm the correct legal entity name and provide a signed W-9 for Redwood Inference (including EIN)? Our payment team also requests a notarized signer affidavit when the W-9 is signed on behalf of an entity (we have the signer as a VP of Finance on the PDF form).

If Redwood is an LLC, please indicate the LLC tax election (disregarded entity / partnership / S-corp / C-corp) on the form or in an accompanying statement — that affects whether we flag the vendor for Form 1099 processing. If you can provide the W-9 and the notarized affidavit (PDFs), we can push the wire this week.

Attachments: Invoice_7812.pdf (stub)

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz

Subject: Re: Outstanding invoice 7812 + W-9 request

Elena —

Thanks for the note and the invoice. I’m looping in Markus (Finance) and Grace (Legal ops) to make sure we provide the right mix of paperwork for your bank. A few quick clarifying items so we send exactly what you need: 

- Legal entity name: "Redwood Inference, Inc."  (we will confirm on the W-9).
- EIN: we will provide the EIN on the attached W-9 PDF. If your process requires masked SSN/EIN on the first pass, let us know and we can supply a redacted copy plus a full copy behind a secure link.
- LLC election: Redwood is a Delaware C-corp — not an LLC, so 1099s are not typically required for corporate entities. However, we will still provide the W-9 for your vendor file. Please confirm whether Medicore requires the notarized signer affidavit as a strict condition for wire release or if a corporate officer signature plus corporate letterhead will suffice. Some banks only need notarization when an agent signs on behalf of a smaller entity.
- Remit details: our AP prefers ACH; I’ll include the remittance instructions in a secure DocuSign/Drive link per your vendor onboarding policy.

Attached I’m sending a completed W-9 template (signed by our Finance Director) and a draft notarization affidavit template we can sign and notarize if you confirm that step is required. If notarization is required, please advise: 1) who at your bank needs to see the affidavit, and 2) whether an electronic notarization is acceptable.

We can fast-track this — if Medicore can confirm wire release date upon paperwork receipt, I’ll prioritize notarization.

Best,
Ava Chen
Head of Partnerships (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0104

Attachments: W-9_Medicore_Requested_Template.pdf (signed stub), Notarization_Affidavit_template.pdf

Ava, Markus —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our AP checklist, I’m attaching the signed W-9 and the notarized signer affidavit. A few notes from Medicore: 

- Attached files: W-9_Medicore_signed.pdf (signed by our contact on the vendor record), Notarized_Signer_Affidavit.pdf, Invoice_7812.pdf (copy).
- Company tax treatment: Medicore is a single-member LLC that has elected to be treated as an S-corp for tax purposes. We understand that corporations are generally exempt from 1099 reporting; we’ll still provide the W-9 so Redwood can retain the record. If your tax team needs any additional confirmation (e.g., a corporate tax letter or EIN verification), let us know.
- Notarization: our bank required notarization of the signer affidavit for new vendor relationships over $50k annual run-rate; we completed an in-person notarization.
- Remit: we have the ACH details on the invoice; please confirm bank account details to trigger the wire. If Redwood prefers a secure DocuSign envelope for the full signed packet, we can resend that link.

Please confirm receipt and indicate the expected payment date once your finance team validates the documents.

Regards,
